raw_text: CERT-In Advisory CIAD-2022-0042: Critical ransomware incident affecting All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi. The incident has been classified as a critical severity cyber security event. Preliminary analysis indicates exploitation of vulnerable servers with outdated operating systems. CERT-In has deployed an incident response team on-site. All government healthcare facilities are advised to immediately audit their network infrastructure, apply latest security patches, and implement network segmentation. Indicators of compromise (IOCs) will be shared through secure channels.
